_comment: Values marked FROM_PAPER are taken verbatim from Bab III text/Table 3.1-3.3. Values marked ASSUMED were left blank in the paper's Table 3.3 and required a reasoned default for this implementation -- see Section 5 / Technical Review discussion in the notebook.

kaggle._note: Auto-downloaded via kagglehub.dataset_download() at notebook startup if credentials are available (env vars KAGGLE_USERNAME/KAGGLE_KEY, ~/.kaggle/kaggle.json, or kagglehub.login()). Falls back to the local root_dir_3dgs/dataset_dir/gt_mesh_dir folders, then to the synthetic scene, if Kaggle is unreachable or unauthenticated -- see Section 3.

sdf_network._source: FROM_PAPER (Bab III: 8 hidden layers x256, Softplus beta=100, geometric init)

joint_refinement._source_weights_and_lr: FROM_PAPER (Bab III: lambda_e=0.1, lambda_n=0.05, eta_gaussian=1e-4, eta_SDF=5e-4, 10000 iters, batch 1024 rays)
joint_refinement._note_smoke_test: ASSUMED: smoke-test iteration count/batch size reduced from the paper's 10000/1024 to keep runtime bounded on this sandbox's single CPU core with no GPU. Not a methodological change -- same loss, same update rule, fewer steps.

transmittance._source: FROM_PAPER for min_opacity_filter (Subbab 3.5 mitigation 1). cull_sigma/max_candidates are ASSUMED engineering-only culling parameters (see transmittance.py docstring) -- they do not change Eq 3.2/3.3, only tractability.

mesh_extraction._source: FROM_PAPER for 512^3 grid and 10% bbox margin. Smoke-test resolution reduced (ASSUMED) for CPU tractability -- same Marching Cubes algorithm, isovalue=0.

evaluation._source: FROM_PAPER (Subbab 3.8: Chamfer bidirectional + F-score at 1mm/5mm, Poisson-disk-like sampling). LPIPS omitted -- see evaluation.py docstring (no offline pretrained VGG weights available in this sandbox).

synthetic_fallback.enabled_reason: No point_cloud.ply / DTU images / camera calibration were uploaded with the paper -- only the thesis document itself. This block configures the clearly-labeled synthetic smoke-test scene (src/synthetic.py), used ONLY when auto-discovery under root_dir_3dgs/dataset_dir finds nothing real.
